entries.title: IXION

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original IXION release and has the best capture/settings route. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are valid 2025 console ports, but they do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Epic, or GOG. Use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S only if a console route is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions are console ports, not remasters or separate game entries.
